idea-plugin.name: SideCode Notes - Sidebar Markdown Notes & Checklists
idea-plugin.description:
SideCode Notes: Apple Notes & Google Keep for JetBrains IDEs

SideCode Notes is a fast, beautiful, and distraction-free note-taking companion docked in your IDE sidebar. Jot down ideas, track task checklists, and capture code snippets without ever leaving your editor.

✨ Key Features

  • Sidebar & Central Editor: Edit notes right inside the compact tool window, or hit Open in Editor to write in a full-sized central tab with live, instantaneous two-way sync.
  • Keep & Apple Notes Aesthetics: Pin key notes to the top, color-code cards with soft pastel palettes, and organize with instant #tags.
  • Interactive Checklists: Insert task items directly alongside text. Click circles to check off items seamlessly.
  • Instant Code Snippet Capture: Right-click any selection in the code editor and choose "Add Selection to Notes" to save a reference-linked Markdown note.
  • Rich Formatting Toolbar: Format with Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough, Highlight markers, Monospace code, custom font sizes (6–200 pt), and timestamps.
  • Multi-Word Search & Scope Filtering: Lightning-fast search by keywords, tags, or pinned status. Easily toggle between Project-specific notes and Global notes available across all your projects.
  • Local-First & Git-Friendly: Your notes are 100% yours. Stored locally as standard .md Markdown files with atomic saves and safe trash recovery. No cloud, no logins, no telemetry.

📁 Storage Locations

  • Project Scope: .idea/notes/ (or .notes/)
  • Global Scope: ~/.pycharm-notes/
  • Trash Recovery: .trash/ inside the corresponding directory
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release of SideCode Notes for PyCharm and JetBrains IDEs (2024.2+).
  • Docked right tool window scratchpad with Apple Notes and Google Keep styling.
  • Instant two-way live editing between sidebar and full-size central editor tabs.
  • Rich formatting toolbar: Bold, Italic, Underline, Strike, Highlighting, Font sizing (6–200 pt), and Monospace.
  • Interactive task checklists with click-to-toggle support.
  • Right-click "Add Selection to Notes" for quick code snippet capture with file & line reference.
  • Multi-word search, tag filtering, and Project vs. Global note scoping.
  • 100% local-first Markdown storage (.md) with atomic saves and trash retention.
